description: Defines the GraphicBufferSource class used for feeding codecs with graphic buffers via BufferQueue in Android's media framework. Includes methods for configuration, control, buffer management, and timestamp handling.

classes.name: GraphicBufferSource
classes.description: A class for managing graphic buffer input to codecs via BufferQueue, handling configuration, control, buffer acquisition, timestamp management, and frame dropping.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Configures the buffer source with component, data space, buffer count, frame dimensions, and usage.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Transitions the source to the executing state, starting buffer handling.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Transitions the source to the stopped state, stopping buffer handling.

methods.name: release
methods.description: Releases resources and shuts down the source.

methods.name: onInputBufferAdded
methods.description: Handles notification that a codec input buffer has been allocated.

methods.name: onInputBufferEmptied
methods.description: Handles notification that a codec input buffer has been released.

methods.name: setSuspend
methods.description: Discards buffers with timestamps after a specified time if suspend is true.

methods.name: setMaxFps
methods.description: Sets maximum frame rate for the source, dropping frames if necessary.

methods.name: setTimeLapseConfig
methods.description: Configures time lapse or slow motion parameters.

methods.name: setStartTimeUs
methods.description: Sets the start time in system time for dropping earlier frames.

methods.name: setStopTimeUs
methods.description: Sets the stop time in system time for dropping later frames.

methods.name: getStopTimeOffsetUs
methods.description: Retrieves the offset between buffer timestamps and stop time.

methods.name: setColorAspects
methods.description: Sets desired color aspects for the input buffers.

methods.name: onFrameAvailable
methods.description: Callback when a new frame is available from BufferQueue.

methods.name: onBuffersReleased
methods.description: Callback when buffers are released by the client.

methods.name: onSidebandStreamChanged
methods.description: Callback when sideband stream changes (no-op here).

methods.name: acquireBuffer_l
methods.description: Acquires a buffer from BufferQueue.

methods.name: submitBuffer_l
methods.description: Submits a buffer to the encoder with timestamp management.

methods.name: submitEndOfInputStream_l
methods.description: Submits an end-of-stream buffer.

methods.name: queueFrameRepeat_l
methods.description: Queues the last frame for re-encoding.

methods.name: setLatestBuffer_l
methods.description: Stores the latest buffer for potential re-encoding.

methods.name: repeatLatestBuffer_l
methods.description: Re-encodes the last buffer if possible.

methods.name: calculateCodecTimestamp_l
methods.description: Calculates media timestamp for buffers based on configuration.
